summary: Iter32 — Instant-execution roadmap step #2: workflow_events auto-materialize into REAL board cards. FULL PASS backend + frontend. BACKEND (pytest, 4/4 pass in 17.24s, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration32.py): (1) owner login → JWT. (2) Toyota+spindles directive → note.status=done in ~10s; execution_summary={tasks:2, assignees:2, approvals:1, workflows:2, meetings:0, reminders:0}; decision mirrors it and carries workflow_ids:[<2 ids>]; /api/workflows now has NEW 'Dispatch Toyota Order' card (type=sales_dispatch, stage=order_received, source=voice, decision_id set, counterparty='Toyota', amount=null) + NEW 'Purchase Order – 50 Spindles from Rajesh Traders' card (type=purchase_payment, stage=requested, source=voice, decision_id set, counterparty='Rajesh Traders', amount=80000). (3) Policy directive 'never dispatch without payment approval' materialized 0 workflow cards (execution_summary.workflows=0) — routed to memory_notes instead. Non-deterministic slip tolerance (≤1) held. (4) execution_summary shape regression: all 6 keys are ints on every note. FRONTEND (Playwright, all assertions pass): Login owner → Decision Desk, submit Toyota+spindles directive → clarify-skip → execution-summary-panel reveals with es-chip-workflows text 'workflows generated' (NOT 'flagged') and es-count-workflows=2 (screenshot confirms '2 workflows generated' chip). Click es-close-btn → nav-workflows → Order Fulfilment tab: 'Dispatch Toyota Order' card visible in ORDER RECEIVED column with Advance button. Procurement tab: 'Purchase Order – 50 Spindles from Rajesh Traders' card visible in REQUESTED column showing ₹80,000 with Advance button. CLEANUP: all test-created data purged from Sharma demo (deleted 2 workflows, 2 tasks, 1 decision, 1 voice_note); /api/workflows count restored to baseline (2 sales_dispatch + 2 purchase_payment).
action_items: (Carried from iter31, still open) Add DELETE endpoints for /api/voice-notes/{id}, /api/decisions/{id}, and /api/workflows/{id} (owner-scoped, with cascade). Cleanup right now requires direct mongo access — brittle for testing agents. The pytest cleanup fixture had to strip quotes from MONGO_URL/DB_NAME because backend/.env uses quoted values; less painful with API-level DELETE.

(Nice-to-have) server.py process_voice_note materializes workflows with counterparty stored verbatim from the LLM. The Toyota card came out with counterparty='Toyota' (extracted from the transcript) — good. Consider adding a `contact_type` hint at insert time so future contact-linkage improvements are simpler.
(Cosmetic — same file) ExecutionSummary chip label reads correctly ('workflows generated'). No fix needed for the chip; roadmap step #2 label change verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:756-783 process_voice_note workflow materialization is clean: iterates extracted['workflow_events'], validates type is in WORKFLOW_STAGES (drops unknown types silently — good defensive behaviour), picks stages[0] as initial stage, best-effort contact_id match by case-insensitive name/company regex on db.contacts. amount is only stored if numeric — safe. history[0] entry records 'Auto-created from directive' with by=note.created_by. decision_id linkage is set. source='voice' is set. LGTM.
server.py:773 amount type-check `isinstance(ev.get('amount'), (int, float))` correctly accepts LLM-returned integers or floats; None/str fallback is null. Verified with the 80000 (int) response.
server.py:789 execution_summary.workflows = len(wf_ids) is the count of ACTUALLY-inserted cards, not the count of extracted workflow_events (which could include unknown types) — correct.
server.py:793 decision update writes both execution_summary AND workflow_ids atomically via a single $set — good.

server.py:407-414 ai_extract prompt correctly scopes workflow_events to concrete order-fulfilment / procurement actions and explicitly excludes policy/rule statements (routes them to memory_notes). Verified by test_3 which had 0 workflow cards materialized for the policy directive.
Workflows.js:87-98 advance() uses PATCH /workflows/{id}/advance and invalidates ['workflows', tab] + ['dashboard'] queries — cache invalidation is complete.

Workflows.js:83-85 stage lists are HARDCODED and duplicate server.py:321-323 WORKFLOW_STAGES. If a stage is added on the backend, frontend column list must be manually updated. Consider exposing GET /api/workflow-stages or embedding stages in the type list. Minor tech debt.
ExecutionSummary.js:31 chip label plural function 'workflow generated'/'workflows generated' matches roadmap step #2 requirement exactly.
server.py has no DELETE for workflows/decisions/voice_notes (still). Testing agents keep polluting demo tenant on failure paths.

server.py:263-268 Workflow pydantic model does NOT include `source` or `decision_id` — but they ARE stored on db.workflows via raw dict insert (server.py:775-782). Response returns raw docs (Mongo strips _id via projection), so the FE sees these fields but the model type declaration lies about the schema. Add source: Optional[str] and decision_id: Optional[str] to the Workflow model for consistency and IDE/OpenAPI support.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Playwright assertions passed: es-chip-workflows label='workflows generated', es-count-workflows=2, Toyota card in order_received column, Spindles/Rajesh card in requested column with ₹80k)

seed_data_creation: None permanent. All test-created data cleaned up. Board restored to baseline: 2 sales_dispatch (Delhi Retailer, Mumbai Boutique) + 2 purchase_payment (PackWell Packaging boxes, Gujarat Cotton Mills yarn). Deleted post-run: 2 workflows, 2 tasks, 1 decision, 1 voice_note (only Toyota directive submitted from UI + 1 policy directive from pytest, but 2nd test run cleanup handled both).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter32 verifies workflow_events → real board cards. Rerun backend: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration32.py -o addopts= -v` (~17s, hits Emergent Claude — non-deterministic but assertions are threshold-based). Playwright selectors verified: [data-testid=text-directive-input], [data-testid=submit-text-directive], [data-testid=clarify-skip], [data-testid=execution-summary-panel], [data-testid=es-chip-workflows], [data-testid=es-count-workflows], [data-testid=es-close-btn], [data-testid=nav-workflows], [data-testid=workflow-tab-sales_dispatch], [data-testid=workflow-tab-purchase_payment], [data-testid=stage-column-order_received], [data-testid=stage-column-requested], [data-testid^=advance-workflow-]. After login the user lands on `/` (Decision Desk), NOT /inbox — use wait_for_selector('[data-testid=text-directive-input]') instead of wait_for_url. AI polling: 90s timeout, 2s interval. CLEANUP is via direct mongo (public API has no DELETE); the pytest fixture handles it, but if you add tests be careful to strip quotes from MONGO_URL when reading /app/backend/.env (values are quoted).
rca of the issue: No bugs. Feature works end-to-end per roadmap step #2 spec: workflow_events extracted by AI now become real Workflow board cards with all required fields (source=voice, decision_id linked, correct type/stage/counterparty/amount), execution_summary.workflows counts the ACTUAL inserted cards, decision.workflow_ids exposes the ids for UI wiring, and the frontend chip label changed from 'flagged' to 'generated' as required. Policy directives correctly bypass materialization and route to memory_notes.
